SELECT e.gmap_id, e.name, e.address, e.avg_rating, e.num_of_reviews, ST_Y(e.geom) as lat, ST_X(e.geom) as lon,
       STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.category, ', ') as categories
FROM establishments e
LEFT JOIN establishment_categories ec ON e.gmap_id = ec.gmap_id
LEFT JOIN category c ON ec.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE ST_DWithin(e.geom, ST_Point(-111.925, 40.785)::GEOMETRY, 0.03) -- roughly 2 miles
GROUP BY e.gmap_id, e.name, e.address, e.avg_rating, e.num_of_reviews, e.geom
HAVING LOWER(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.category, ', ')) LIKE '%breakfast%'
    OR LOWER(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.category, ', ')) LIKE '%diner%'
    OR LOWER(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.category, ', ')) LIKE '%mexican%'
    OR LOWER(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.category, ', ')) LIKE '%cafe%'
    OR LOWER(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.category, ', ')) LIKE '%burrito%'
    OR LOWER(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.category, ', ')) LIKE '%american%'
    OR LOWER(e.name) LIKE '%breakfast%'
    OR LOWER(e.name) LIKE '%cafe%'
    OR LOWER(e.name) LIKE '%diner%'
    OR LOWER(e.name) LIKE '%grill%'
    OR LOWER(e.name) LIKE '%taco%'
    OR LOWER(e.name) LIKE '%burrito%'
ORDER BY e.num_of_reviews DESC
LIMIT 30;

       e.slchd_establishment_key,
       STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.category, ', ') as categories
FROM establishments e
LEFT JOIN establishment_categories ec ON e.gmap_id = ec.gmap_id
LEFT JOIN category c ON ec.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE (e.address ILIKE '%84116%' OR ST_DWithin(e.geom, ST_Point(-111.925, 40.785)::GEOMETRY, 0.025))
  AND (
       LOWER(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.category, ', ')) LIKE '%mexican%'
    OR LOWER(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.category, ', ')) LIKE '%diner%'
    OR LOWER(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.category, ', ')) LIKE '%breakfast%'
    OR LOWER(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.category, ', ')) LIKE '%american%'
    OR LOWER(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.category, ', ')) LIKE '%burrito%'
    OR LOWER(e.name) LIKE '%chubby%'
    OR LOWER(e.name) LIKE '%cabrito%'
    OR LOWER(e.name) LIKE '%santo%'
    OR LOWER(e.name) LIKE '%denny%'
    OR LOWER(e.name) LIKE '%nico%'
    OR LOWER(e.name) LIKE '%rancherito%'
    OR LOWER(e.name) LIKE '%hacienda%'
    OR LOWER(e.name) LIKE '%asadero%'
  )
GROUP BY e.name, e.address, e.avg_rating, e.num_of_reviews, e.price, e.slchd_establishment_key, e.geom
HAVING e.num_of_reviews >= 50
ORDER BY e.avg_rating DESC, e.num_of_reviews DESC;

WITH cat_agg AS (
    SELECT e.gmap_id, e.name, e.address, e.avg_rating, e.num_of_reviews, e.price,
           e.slchd_establishment_key, ST_Y(e.geom) as lat, ST_X(e.geom) as lon,
           STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.category, ', ') as categories
    FROM establishments e
    LEFT JOIN establishment_categories ec ON e.gmap_id = ec.gmap_id
    LEFT JOIN category c ON ec.category_id = c.category_id
    WHERE e.address ILIKE '%84116%' OR ST_DWithin(e.geom, ST_Point(-111.925, 40.785)::GEOMETRY, 0.025)
    GROUP BY e.gmap_id, e.name, e.address, e.avg_rating, e.num_of_reviews, e.price, e.slchd_establishment_key, e.geom
)
SELECT name, address, avg_rating, num_of_reviews, price, categories, slchd_establishment_key, lat, lon
FROM cat_agg
WHERE num_of_reviews >= 50
  AND (
       LOWER(categories) LIKE '%mexican%'
    OR LOWER(categories) LIKE '%diner%'
    OR LOWER(categories) LIKE '%breakfast%'
    OR LOWER(categories) LIKE '%american%'
    OR LOWER(categories) LIKE '%burrito%'
    OR LOWER(categories) LIKE '%cafe%'
    OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%chubby%'
    OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%cabrito%'
    OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%santo%'
  )
ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, num_of_reviews DESC;
